critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: two @app.on_event('shutdown') handlers registered (_stop_bot and shutdown_db_client) — both run but relying on registration order is fragile; consider merging into one shutdown hook. Also on_event is deprecated in newer FastAPI (use lifespan). Non-blocking.
